mechanics.settlement: Accumulate arena quest/battle contributions durably per life; publish at server life end (death or voluntary exit)
mechanics.deadline: Life ending at or after deadline forfeits pending contribution to that closed quest/battle; no deadline auto-credit
mechanics.xp: Only actual awarded personal XP; personal cap unchanged
mechanics.kills: Actual awarded natural kills included in quest kills; no visual-only capped rewards
mechanics.migration: Existing unfinished quest progress preserved; approved lower targets applied; already settled history unchanged
mechanics.recovery: Saved contribution only, no offline time; exact repeats do not duplicate credit
mechanics.clanLevelXp: Clan level XP remains immediate; this change batches quests/battles, not all clan mutations
